name: Editorial Quote Card
description: High-contrast editorial quote and insight card with serif pull-quote typography, author attribution, role/company subtitle, category pill, and monogram badge.
distillationHint: Extract a single sharp, self-contained insight or quote (80-200 characters). Pair it with the speaker's name, concise role/company, and a 1-2 word category tag.

category.label: Category Badge
category.description: Short topic pill shown in the top header (e.g., ENGINEERING, AI SYSTEMS, PRODUCT).

quote.label: Quote / Insight
quote.description: Primary distilled quote or takeaway statement.

author.label: Author Name
author.description: Name of the speaker, author, or publication.

role.label: Role or Source
role.description: Author title, organization, or source context.

handle.label: Social Handle / URL
handle.description: Optional handle or domain shown in the footer right (e.g., @tinytldr).

avatarUrl.label: Avatar Image
avatarUrl.description: Optional data URL or local image path for author avatar.

sampleData.quote: The best developer tools don't guess with another model call—they turn structured intent into deterministic, pixel-accurate artifacts.
